verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents a no-cost way to prototype: it is Apache 2.0 open source, runs locally, and `helix chef` scaffolds a local instance with example data without any Cloud login. There is no documented free hosted tier, and a community member reports Helix Cloud starting around $600/mo, above their experimentation budget. Missing for 10: a documented free Helix Cloud tier with stated limits, published pricing-plan details, and independent confirmation that local prototyping is fully free.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: Open source: Apache 2.0 licensed and developed in the open on GitHub.
`helix chef` can automate local scaffolding and agent setup without any Cloud login.
scaffolds a project, starts a local instance, seeds some example data
